transit.header: Long Beach Branch service is suspended due to flooding near Island Park.
transit.description:
Shuttle bus service is available between Valley Stream and Long Beach.

For service to points east of Jamaica along the Long Beach Branch, customers can take a Babylon or Far Rockaway Branch train. 

In addition, NICE bus service is cross-honoring LIRR tickets on the following routes:
N15 bus between Long Beach and Rockville Centre. Customers can transfer to a westbound Babylon Branch train at Rockville Centre .
Check NICE bus schedules at https://www.nicebus.com/ to plan your trip.

Use this link for a map of travel alternatives.
